text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove has shown us all a
spectacular race
today! She really is the
Empress through and
through!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's almost as if that terror I felt never
existed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm just excited to take
Suzuka on. My
heart is aching for the
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
All that's left is to set our sights
on
Suzuka's next race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is to say, the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's where I'll challenge Suzuka once
again!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This time I'll challenge you without an
ounce of
fear in my heart!
